sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 573)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across the illustrious history of British radio drama on the BBC and American psychological detective mysteries, Ray Collins in *Crime Doctor* for Philip Morris (1946), alongside a five-decade retrospective of the BBC's flagship *Saturday Night Theatre* presenting Sutton Vane's metaphysical masterpiece *Outward Bound* (1945), *The Raphael Resurrection* (1951), Hugh Hastings's *Seagulls Over Sorrento* (1956), *This Land of Ours* (1962), and *The Rise and Fall of Liberty Wilkes* (1973):
